glosses: any item or substance intended for human consumption (excluding drugs other than alcohol), food, comestible
groceries; roughly, though not usually including housewares

examples.en: How much food do you need?

examples.text: Ich habe keine Lebensmittel im Haus.
examples.en: I have no food in my house.

examples.text: Ich habe kaum genug Geld für Lebensmittel.
examples.en: I barely have enough money for groceries.

examples.text: Brot und Milch sind gute Lebensmittel.
examples.en: Bread and milk are good foods.
